name: viewer-code
title: Code viewers
description: The SVG, CSV and code kinds: `svgKind` (a preview from a blob URL, or its source), `codeKind` (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, shell and JSON with coloured syntax and numbered lines, no highlighter dependency) and `csvKind` (a table, with an « @ » action on each row where the shell offers one: `RowReferenceContext`), drawn inside the artifact panel's bar. Each view loads the first time its artifact opens; other text stays in the panel's code block.
